description.value: Pallino's Italian Bistro is a casual sit-down restaurant located inside Predator Ridge Resort, a master-planned resort community in the Okanagan Valley about 15 minutes south of Vernon. The kitchen turns out signature thin-crust pizzas, baked pastas, and freshly made sandwiches using locally sourced ingredients, paired with Italian wines, craft beers, and specialty coffee. The resort is a notable cycling destination with 13 km of on-site biking trails connecting to 40+ km at Ellison Provincial Park, and offers a dedicated 'Ride & Stay' package, making Pallino's a natural meal stop for touring and trail cyclists in the area.
